name: mcwm_closed_loop_load_coverage_v89_20261028

observation.sample: Every7X control issue in the fixed window, before native action application; capture load before action-domain classification
observation.native_load: len(vehicle.getPersonIDList(trip_id))/vehicle.getPersonCapacity(trip_id); never use event-time canonical load as the issue-native substitute
observation.clocks: Record event and issue separately; native observation starts and ends at issue clock
observation.guards: Clock, passenger ledger and Python/NumPy/Torch RNG unchanged
observation.coverage: Retain every issue, including original F-domain exclusions and missing native observations
observation.trace_replay: Exact streamed comparison of every network issue from0 to12600 with the old v88 parent trace; require equal row counts and exhausted reference EOF

stratification.eligible: All atomic observed rows in the original action domain, only after complete native and trace audits pass
stratification.algorithm: U=sorted(distinct eligible load ratios); require len(U)>=2; k=(len(U)-1)//2; cut=(U[k]+U[k+1])/2
stratification.weighting: Distinct service states determine the split, not record frequency, rewards or cost labels
stratification.old_half_capacity_split: Report separately; do not relabel the old missing v88 high state as covered
stratification.scope: Freezes attainable7X sampling strata only; continuous service features, conditional/line model formulas, actor/F/trust and single-intervention control rule are unchanged

decision_gate: Same frozen actor and exact v88 parent prefix through real12600, nonterminal
All seven-X issue observations accounted for with atomic clock/ledger/RNG guards and native load
Zero suffixes, response or TD labels, fits, neural updates, feedback and v87 truth
At least two distinct observed in-domain load values and nonempty lighter/heavier groups
artifacts: Raw rows and new trace stay resident; only freeze audit and bounded distribution/strata summary are pulled
stop_rule: End after observing and freezing a covariate-only stratification when eligible; decide formal collection separately. No new suffixes, labels, fits, retries, window extensions, future-outcome selection or v87 feedback.
scientific_scope: Attainable native-load sampling coverage, not action-value correctness or passenger-cost benefit. New heavier stratum is relative to the observed7X domain, not necessarily50% capacity.
